title: Felix and the Sigil
author: S. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Cyrus Blackwood, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
